title: How Things Are Made
description: Mendeskripsikan proses pembuatan produk, penemuan, dan fakta sejarah dengan passive voice. Kamu akan belajar present simple passive, past simple passive, kapan memakai by + agent, serta bentuk negatif dan pertanyaan passive.
objectives: Membentuk present simple passive (am/is/are + V3) untuk fakta dan proses
Membentuk past simple passive (was/were + V3) untuk sejarah dan kejadian lampau
Memutuskan kapan pelaku (by + agent) perlu disebut atau dihilangkan
Mendeskripsikan proses produksi dan penemuan dengan kosakata yang tepat

lessons.title: The Present Simple Passive
lessons.summary: Memakai am/is/are + V3 untuk menjelaskan fakta, rutinitas, dan proses ketika pelaku tidak penting.
objectives: Membentuk present simple passive dengan am/is/are + V3
Mengubah kalimat active sederhana menjadi passive
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Active vs passive
Dalam kalimat **active**, subjek *melakukan* aksi: *Farmers grow rice in this valley.* Dalam kalimat **passive**, subjek *menerima* aksi: *Rice is grown in this valley.* We use the passive when the action, or the thing affected by it, is more important than the person who does it. Bentuk ini mirip dengan kata kerja **di-** dalam bahasa Indonesia: *Nasi dimasak. Surat dikirim. Kopi ditanam.*

### Bentuk present simple passive
| Subject | be | Past participle (V3) | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | am | paid, invited... | I am paid every Friday. |
| He / She / It | is | baked, cleaned... | The bread is baked every morning. |
| You / We / They | are | made, checked... | These bags are made by hand. |

Rumusnya: **am/is/are + V3**. The form of *be* agrees with the NEW subject (singular → *is*, plural → *are*). The main verb is always the past participle — never V1 and never V-ing.

### Kapan dipakai?
- **Facts and general truths:** *Coffee is grown in the hills of Mount Ardan.*
- **Processes (proses pembuatan):** *The leaves are picked, dried and packed.*
- **Routines and rules:** *The office is cleaned every evening. Visitors are asked to sign in.*
- When the doer is unknown, obvious, or not interesting: siapa yang membersihkan kantor? Tidak penting — yang penting kantornya bersih.

### Active → passive, langkah demi langkah
1. The **object** of the active sentence becomes the new subject: *They clean the rooms* → *The rooms...*
2. Tambahkan *am/is/are* sesuai subject baru: *The rooms are...*
3. Ubah kata kerja menjadi V3: *The rooms are cleaned.*
4. Pelaku umum seperti *they, people, someone* biasanya dihilangkan: *The rooms are cleaned every day.*

### Hati-hati
- Uncountable nouns (*rice, paper, coffee, water*) memakai **is**: *Paper is made from wood.*
- Jangan lupa *be*: ~~Rice grown here.~~ → *Rice is grown here.*
- Only verbs that take an object can be passive. Kata kerja seperti *happen, arrive, sleep* tidak bisa dijadikan passive: ~~The festival is happened every year~~ → *The festival happens every year.*

These baskets are made by hand.

lessons.title: The Past Simple Passive
lessons.summary: Memakai was/were + V3 untuk sejarah, kejadian lampau, dan peristiwa yang pelakunya tidak diketahui.
objectives: Membentuk past simple passive dengan was/were + V3
Menggunakan past passive untuk fakta sejarah dan kejadian seperti pencurian atau kerusakan
Memilih was atau were sesuai subject

sections.explanation:
### Bentuk past simple passive
Rumusnya sama seperti present passive, tetapi *be* diubah ke bentuk lampau: **was/were + V3**.

| Subject | be | V3 | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| I / He / She / It | was | built, stolen... | The bridge was built in 1925. |
| You / We / They | were | sent, destroyed... | The letters were sent yesterday. |

Active: *Workers built the bridge in 1925.* → Passive: *The bridge was built in 1925.* The time expression (*in 1925, last night, two years ago*) stays at the end.

### Kapan dipakai?
- **History and famous facts (sejarah):** *The town hall was built in 1890. Port Selwyn was founded by fishermen.*
- **Crime, accidents and damage:** *My bike was stolen last night. Ten houses were damaged in the storm.* Biasanya kita tidak tahu siapa pelakunya, atau pelakunya tidak penting.
- **News:** *Two new schools were opened last month.*

Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita cukup bilang *Jembatan itu dibangun tahun 1925* — tidak ada perubahan bentuk untuk waktu lampau. In English, *was/were* shows that the action is finished and in the past.

### Irregular past participles
Banyak kata kerja yang sering muncul dalam past passive adalah irregular:

| V1 | V2 | V3 |
|---|---|---|
| build | built | built |
| steal | stole | stolen |
| write | wrote | written |
| break | broke | broken |
| take | took | taken |

Be careful: *stole* is V2 (active), *stolen* is V3 (passive). *My phone was stole* is wrong.

### Present atau past passive?
- Fakta yang masih benar sekarang → present: *Rice is grown here.*
- Kejadian yang selesai di masa lalu → past: *The first rice mill was built here in 1950.*

### Hati-hati: found vs find
*Found* (mendirikan) adalah regular verb: found – founded – founded. *Find* (menemukan) adalah irregular: find – found – found. So: *The school was founded in 1960* (didirikan), but *The keys were found under the sofa* (ditemukan).

lessons.title: Who Did It? By + Agent
lessons.summary: Memutuskan kapan pelaku perlu disebut dengan by, serta membedakan by, with, made of, dan made from.
objectives: Menambahkan pelaku dengan by + agent ketika informasinya penting

sections.explanation:
### Apa itu agent?
The **agent** is the person or thing that does the action in a passive sentence. Kita menyebutnya dengan **by**: *The library was designed by Ayu Lestari.* (Perpustakaan itu dirancang **oleh** Ayu Lestari.)

### Kapan agent DISEBUT?
Include *by + agent* when it is **new or important information** — biasanya nama orang, seniman, penulis, atau penemu:
- *This song was written by Raka Pratama.*
- *The fire was started by a cigarette.*
- *The thief was caught by a taxi driver.* (menarik — bukan polisi!)

### Kapan agent DIHILANGKAN?
| Situation | Example |
|---|---|
| Unknown (tidak diketahui) | *My car was stolen.* (oleh siapa? tidak tahu) |
| Obvious (sudah jelas) | *The thief was arrested.* (tentu oleh polisi) |
| Not important | *The streets are cleaned every day.* |
| General people / pronouns | ~~by people~~, ~~by them~~, ~~by someone~~ |

Secara umum, jika kalimat active memakai *they, people, someone, we*, jangan tulis *by them / by people* dalam kalimat passive. It sounds unnatural.

### By, with, made of, made from
- **by** + doer (pelaku): *The cake was made by my grandmother.*
- **with** + tool/instrument (alat): *The cake was decorated with a small knife.*
- **made of** + material you can still see: *This table is made of wood.*
- **made from** + material that has changed: *Paper is made from wood.*

Dalam bahasa Indonesia semua bisa diterjemahkan *oleh / dengan / dari*, jadi pilihlah preposisi berdasarkan fungsinya, bukan terjemahannya. Do NOT use *from* or *of* for the doer: ~~written from a young musician~~ → *written by a young musician*.

### Posisi agent
The agent usually comes after the verb, before or after the time phrase: *The bridge was designed by a local engineer in 1990.* Keep the most important information near the end of the sentence — that is where English speakers put new information.

lessons.title: Passive Questions and Negatives
lessons.summary: Membuat kalimat negatif, pertanyaan yes/no, dan pertanyaan wh- dalam present dan past simple passive.
objectives: Membentuk kalimat negatif passive dengan isn't/aren't/wasn't/weren't + V3
Membuat pertanyaan passive: Is/Was + subject + V3?
Menjawab dengan short answer yang tepat
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Negatif
Untuk membuat passive negatif, tambahkan **not** setelah *be*. We never use *don't/doesn't/didn't* in a passive sentence.

| Tense | Negative | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Present | am not / isn't / aren't + V3 | *These shoes aren't made in our factory.* |
| Past | wasn't / weren't + V3 | *Bayu wasn't invited to the meeting.* |

### Pertanyaan yes/no
Pindahkan *be* ke depan subject — sama seperti pertanyaan dengan *be* yang sudah kamu kenal sejak A1.
- *This bag is made of leather.* → **Is this bag made of leather?**
- *The bridge was built in 1925.* → **Was the bridge built in 1925?**

Short answers use *be*, not *do*: *Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. / Yes, it was. / No, they weren't.*

### Pertanyaan wh-
Pola: **Wh- word + is/are/was/were + subject + V3?**
- *Where was this film made?*
- *When were these photos taken?*
- *How is cheese made?*
- *What is this tool used for?*

Ingat urutannya: *be* sebelum subject, dan V3 tetap di belakang subject. A very common mistake is ~~Where was made this film?~~ — the subject (*this film*) must come between *was* and *made*.

### Bertanya tentang pelaku
To ask about the agent, put **by** at the end: *Who was this book written by?* Jawaban: *It was written by Mira Halim.* In conversation, this is more common than *By whom was this book written?*, yang terdengar sangat formal.

### Do/did atau be?
| Active | Passive |
|---|---|
| *Did they build the bridge?* | *Was the bridge built?* |
| *They don't make shoes here.* | *Shoes aren't made here.* |

Kesimpulannya: dalam passive, *be* melakukan semua pekerjaan — ia membuat pertanyaan, negatif, dan short answer. *Do/does/did* hanya untuk kalimat active.

lessons.title: Processes and Inventions
lessons.summary: Mendeskripsikan proses produksi langkah demi langkah dan sejarah penemuan dengan passive dan sequencers.
objectives: Menjelaskan proses pembuatan produk dengan present passive dan sequencers
Menceritakan sejarah sebuah penemuan dengan past passive
Menggunakan kosakata produksi: harvest, roast, pack, export, assemble, manufacture
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Mendeskripsikan proses
When we explain how something is made, we usually use the **present simple passive**, because the steps are more important than the workers. Tambahkan **sequencers** supaya urutannya jelas:

| Step | Sequencer | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | First, / First of all, | *First, the cocoa pods are harvested.* |
| 2 | Then / Next, | *Next, the beans are removed and dried.* |
| 3 | After that, | *After that, they are roasted.* |
| 4 | Finally, | *Finally, the chocolate is wrapped and sent to shops.* |

Kalau dua langkah memakai subject yang sama, kamu tidak perlu mengulang *are*: *The leaves are picked, dried and packed.*

### Contoh: bagaimana tempe dibuat
*First, the soybeans are washed and boiled. Then the skins are removed. After that, the beans are mixed with a starter and wrapped in banana leaves. Finally, they are left in a warm place for one or two days.* Perhatikan: semua kata kerja utama berbentuk **is/are + V3**.

### Menceritakan sejarah penemuan
For the history of an invention or a company, use the **past simple passive**, and add *by + agent* when the inventor's name is important:
- *The Selwyn radio was invented in 1958 by an engineer called Hadi Wirawan.*
- *At first, the radios were assembled by hand. Later, they were manufactured in a large factory and exported to five countries.*

### Kosakata produksi
| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| harvest | memanen |
| roast | memanggang/menyangrai (kopi, kacang) |
| pack / wrap | mengemas / membungkus |
| assemble | merakit |
| manufacture | memproduksi dalam jumlah besar di pabrik |
| export / import | mengekspor / mengimpor |
| invent | menemukan/menciptakan sesuatu yang baru |

### Tips menulis
Mix active and passive naturally. Kalimat tentang **proses** → passive; kalimat tentang **orang** yang melakukan sesuatu dengan sengaja → boleh active: *Hadi Wirawan worked in a small garage. His first radio was built there in 1958.*

grammar.example: Then the leaves are dried in the sun.
grammar.note: First, Then, Next, After that, Finally.

grammar.pattern: Subject + are + V3, V3 and V3
grammar.example: The leaves are picked, dried and packed.
grammar.note: Be tidak perlu diulang untuk subject yang sama.

grammar.pattern: Subject + was/were + V3 + in + year + by + inventor
grammar.example: The Selwyn radio was invented in 1958 by Hadi Wirawan.

mistakes.wrong: First, the beans roasted.
mistakes.right: First, the beans are roasted.
mistakes.why: Proses membutuhkan be + V3; tanpa are, kalimat ini berarti biji-biji itu yang memanggang.

mistakes.wrong: Our products are export to twelve countries.
mistakes.right: Our products are exported to twelve countries.
mistakes.why: Setelah are pakai V3 (exported).

mistakes.wrong: The radio was invent in 1958.
mistakes.right: The radio was invented in 1958.
mistakes.why: Regular verb: V3 = V1 + -ed.

mistakes.wrong: The parts are assembled in our factory and then they packed.
mistakes.right: The parts are assembled in our factory and then they are packed.
mistakes.why: Subject baru (they) membutuhkan be lagi: they are packed.

sections.summary: To describe a **process**, use the present passive with sequencers (*First, Then, After that, Finally*). To tell the **history** of an invention, use the past passive and add *by + agent* when the name matters. Kuasai kosakata seperti *harvest, roast, assemble, manufacture, export, wrap*.

memproduksi di pabrik dalam jumlah besar

reviewCards.front: Proses → tense apa? Sejarah penemuan → tense apa?
reviewCards.back: Proses: present simple passive. Sejarah: past simple passive.

questions.prompt: At the end of the process, the chocolate bars are ___ in paper and put into boxes.
questions.explanation: Cokelat dibungkus kertas → **wrapped**. *Harvested* (dipanen) dan *roasted* (disangrai) adalah langkah awal, dan *invented* berarti diciptakan.

questions.prompt: Put the parts in the correct order to describe the process.
fragments: First, the tea leaves are picked by hand,
then they are dried in the sun,
questions.explanation: Ikuti sequencers: **First → then → finally**. Setiap langkah memakai present passive: *are picked, are dried, are packed (and) sent*.

questions.prompt: Describe how a food or product from your region is made (for example tempe, batik, or coffee). Speak for about one minute. Use at least four passive sentences and sequencers.
questions.sampleAnswer: I'd like to explain how tempe is made. First, the soybeans are washed and boiled. Then the skins are removed. After that, the beans are mixed with a starter and wrapped in banana leaves. Finally, they are left in a warm place for one or two days, and the tempe is ready.
questions.explanation: Gunakan **is/are + V3** untuk setiap langkah dan hubungkan dengan sequencers. Speak clearly and pause briefly after each step.

make goods in large numbers in a factory

questions.explanation: invent = menciptakan, manufacture = memproduksi di pabrik, harvest = memanen, export = mengekspor, assemble = merakit.

questions.prompt: Complete the text with the present simple passive of the verbs in brackets.
questions.text: Batik ___ (produce) in many towns in Java. First, patterns ___ (draw) on the cloth with hot wax. Then the cloth ___ (dye).
questions.explanation: *Batik* dan *the cloth* singular → **is produced, is dyed**. *Patterns* plural → **are drawn** (draw – drew – drawn).

questions.prompt: Select ALL the grammatically correct sentences.
options: The first Selwyn radio was designed in 1958.
The parts are assembled in our factory.
This model was invent by two students.
Our products are export to twelve countries.
Each machine was tested before it was sold.
The boxes is packed by robots.
questions.explanation: Kalimat benar memakai **be + V3** yang sesuai subject. Errors: *was invent* → *was invented*; *are export* → *are exported*; *The boxes is* → *The boxes are*.

unitTestQuestions.explanation: Kertas **dibuat** dari kayu (fakta umum) → present passive **is made**. *Paper* is uncountable, so we use *is*.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete with the correct passive form of the verbs in brackets.
unitTestQuestions.text: The Port Selwyn Maritime Museum ___ (open) in 1998. Today it ___ (visit) by thousands of tourists every year.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: *In 1998* → past passive **was opened**. *Today ... every year* → fakta sekarang → present passive **is visited**.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Find the incorrect part of the question.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Subject *these photos* plural → **were**: *Where were these photos taken?*

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence in the passive. Leave out the agent.
unitTestQuestions.sentence: Somebody stole my wallet on the bus.
answers: My wallet was stolen on the bus.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: *Stole* (past) → **was stolen**. Pelaku *somebody* tidak diketahui, jadi dihilangkan.

unitTestQuestions.source: Kopi ini ditanam di lereng Gunung Ardan.
answers: This coffee is grown on the slopes of Mount Ardan
This coffee is grown on the slope of Mount Ardan
This coffee is grown on Mount Ardan's slopes
This coffee is planted on the slopes of Mount Ardan
This coffee is planted on the slope of Mount Ardan
unitTestQuestions.explanation: *Ditanam* sebagai fakta umum → present passive **is grown** (atau *is planted*). *Lereng* = *slope(s)*.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Is this table made of wood?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.text: It's made of metal, but it looks like wood.

unitTestQuestions.explanation: Pertanyaan memakai *Is ... made?* → short answer **No, it isn't.** *Doesn't* tidak dipakai dalam passive, *they* tidak cocok dengan *this table*, dan *wasn't* salah tense.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a question.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Yes/no question past passive: **Was + subject + V3 + by + agent?** → *Was the bridge designed by a local engineer?*

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Most of the coffee from our island is ___ to other countries, so it is hard to buy it in local shops.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Kopi dijual ke negara lain → **exported**. *Imported* berarti dibeli dari luar negeri — kebalikannya.
